# ViewportFrame

- Inherits [`UIObject`](uiobject.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("ViewportFrame")`

A UI element that draws the parts and models inside it (ADR 0107): an item turning in an inventory slot, a character preview, a 3D icon. **What is inside is its world and nothing else's**: drawn here and nowhere else, and not simulated -- no physics, no collisions -- so a script moves it by setting `CFrame`.

Drawn only when something inside it, its camera or its size changes, so forty still items cost forty pictures once. Lit by its own simple light, with no sky: with `BackgroundTransparency = 1` only the instances show. It works in a `SurfaceGui` too.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

| `Ambient` | `Color3` | `Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 150)` | read/write | The light from every direction. |

| `LightColor` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(1, 1, 1)` | read/write | The colour of its one light. |
| `LightDirection` | `vector` | `vector.create(-1, -1, -1)` | read/write | Which way its one light travels -- down and away from the viewer by default. |
